The test image shows a soybean field with lower canopy yellowing/browning while the upper canopy remains green, with some patchy distribution across the field.

Key visual features:
- Field-level view showing yellowing concentrated in lower/middle canopy
- Upper canopy still predominantly green
- Some patchy distribution of affected areas

Comparing to the Sudden Death Syndrome reference: the bottom-right panel shows a nearly identical field view with similar yellowing patterns. SDS typically presents with interveinal chlorosis starting in the lower canopy, with petioles remaining attached after leaflets drop — consistent with the leaf drop visible in the foreground of the test image.
